'''''Verity''''' was a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] in use in [[44 ABY]]. Following a [[Operation Shieldfall|battle]] with [[Abeloth]] and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] recovered in a [[Bacta tank/Legends|bacta tank]] on ''Verity''.
